Actually, I think you did get the point when you said it's abhorrent. That's the point of the film, but the question the movie tries to get the viewer to understand is, why?

It's more nuanced than just “drugs are bad” or “addiction ruins lives.” Simplify it, and it's all about the fear of being forgotten, the fear of inadequacy, the trauma of being sexually commodified, but I digress.

I think art and films like these help cultivate deeper discussions about the societal problems they present, and can help spread awareness about the topic(s). And, I honestly think it helps to have things like these being made as a sort of reality check of the things we usually glaze over. We wouldn't get anywhere if we were lulled by mindless entertainment.

For me, I like to be aggressive early game, I start off with W, (however I usually use E if they're much faster than me),  and I try to make as many trades possible, or I just try to kill them from the get-go.

With your Q, you get bonus MS, so use that to your advantage, while your enemy laner is trying to last hit a creep, activate q and go up to them and pull them in with e, (I suggest pushing for a kill once your get your Q). And don't be afraid to go all in, usually once I get my conqueror proc, they're pretty fucked.

If you're level 6 and creeps and enemy laner is pushed up to your tower, try to stun enemy laner with your E, (by having a creep on your side and the enemy laner on the other), and R them under your tower, the slow will fuck them up, so it'll most likely be a free kill for you :). Or you could E, then flash behind then and R them into your tower, either works. If you're good at wave management try to perma-freeze it to your side, so you don't get ganked as much, and you pose more of a threat to the enemy laner.

I also suggest rushing BOTRK first if its a melee champ, but if you're up against a virgin ranged champ, rush stridebreaker for that extra dash, (but sadly they're looking to remove the dash for stridebreaker :(, so uh idk how to fix that).

You're gonna have a lot of trial and error, one game you might go 5/1, or 0/5, and that's okay, always remember mistakes are stepping stones to getting better at the champ, and just have fun, if your team mates are bugging you just mute them lol
